meta.data_description_zh:
1. 可參考全民健康保險罕見疾病申請核發重大傷病證明作業須知。
2. 罕病通報流程（醫療院所、國健署）
（一）依罕見疾病防治及藥物法第七條規定「醫事人員發現罹患罕見疾病
之病人或因而致死者，應向中央主管機關報告。主政機關為衛生署
國民健康署。
（二）保險對象就醫時醫師診斷若為罕見之疾病，爰依前項規定至罕見疾
病整合式資訊管理系統填報個案資料，向衛生署國民健康署辦理通
報。
（三）國健署受理通報並經委員專家審查後，審查結果登錄罕見疾病資料
庫（審查結果包括審查通過、未通過、審查中，審查約需時 10工作
日），審查結果該署會發函通知通報醫院並副知健保署。
3. 罕病定義以衛生福利部公告之罕見疾病（主診斷代碼、中英文病名、罕病
序號），並登錄於罕病資料庫之確認個案為限。
4. 資料年度 2012-202202
meta.notes_zh:
1. 本檔無提供 ID識別碼。
2. 其他資料可參考：全民健康保險罕見疾病申請核發重大傷病證明作業須知。
※本資料庫身分證字號、出生日期等欄位均經屏蔽處理，相關資料僅能於本部
設置之獨立作業區內使用，並攜出經審核通過之統計結果，以確保資料應用及
其揭露方式已無從識別特定當事人。
meta.data_description_en:
1. See the Operating Notes for Applying for Catastrophic Illness/Injury Certificates for Rare Diseases under National Health Insurance.
2. Rare disease reporting process (medical institutions, HPA)
(1) Under Article 7 of the Rare Disease Prevention and Drug Act, "medical personnel who find a patient with a rare disease
or a death caused by one must report to the central competent authority." The responsible authority is the Health Promotion Administration,
Department of Health.
(2) When an insured person's physician diagnoses a rare disease, the case data must be entered under the preceding provision into the Rare Disease
Integrated Information Management System and reported to the Health Promotion Administration,
Department of Health.
(3) After the HPA accepts the report and it is reviewed by expert committee members, the review result is recorded in the rare disease
database (results include approved, not approved and under review; review takes about 10 working
days), and the HPA sends an official letter notifying the reporting hospital, with a copy to the NHIA.
3. Rare diseases are defined as those announced by the Ministry of Health and Welfare (principal diagnosis code, Chinese and English disease names, rare disease
serial number), limited to confirmed cases registered in the rare disease database.
4. Data years: 2012-202202
meta.notes_en:
1. This file provides no ID identifier.
2. For other information, see the Operating Guidelines for Applying for and Issuing Catastrophic Illness Certificates for Rare Diseases under National Health Insurance.
※ This database's national ID number, date of birth and other fields are masked; the data may be used
only in the independent work area set up by this Ministry, and only statistical results that pass review
may be taken out, to ensure that the use and disclosure of the data cannot identify any specific individual.
